x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      BEMS
      or stemmed "HVAC flexibility"
      or stemmed "active building"
      or stemmed "building energy management system"
      or stemmed "building thermal flexibility"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive building"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive efficient building"
      or stemmed "smart building"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "backup power"
      or stemmed "critical load"
      or stemmed "emergency operation"
      or islanding
      or outage
      or resilience
    )
  )
